summary: Comprehensive testing of Phase 2 (Approval Workflow) and Phase 3 (Surveys, Pulse Checks, Feedback, Interaction Dashboard). All 26 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend tests passed - Surveys page loads with tabs (Umfragen, Pulse-Checks, Feedback), survey editor with all question types, feedback dialog with categories, interaction stats dashboard, and news approval workflow UI.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console) - same as iteration_53

critical_code_review_comments: Phase 2 - Approval Workflow correctly implemented:
- POST /api/news/posts/{id}/submit-review changes status to 'review' with approval_status='pending_review' ✓
- POST /api/news/posts/{id}/approve-review - Admin/Freigeber publishes directly (status='published', approval_status='approved') ✓
- POST /api/news/posts/{id}/approve-review - Redakteur forwards to approval (status='approval', approval_status='pending_approval') ✓
- POST /api/news/posts/{id}/reject returns to draft with reason (status='draft', approval_status='rejected', rejection_reason stored) ✓
- GET /api/news/approval-queue returns posts in review/approval status ✓
- GET /api/news/audit/{post_id} returns audit trail entries with action, user_id, timestamp, details ✓
Phase 3 - Surveys correctly implemented:
- POST /api/surveys creates survey with questions (single_choice, multiple_choice, free_text, scale) ✓
- GET /api/surveys returns published surveys with participation status and response_count ✓
- GET /api/surveys/{id} returns survey with my_response field ✓
- POST /api/surveys/{id}/respond submits answers and prevents double submission (400 error) ✓
- GET /api/surveys/{id}/results returns aggregated results per question type ✓
- DELETE /api/surveys/{id} deletes survey and all responses ✓
Phase 3 - Pulse Checks correctly implemented:
- GET /api/pulse-checks returns only pulse_check type surveys ✓
- Pulse checks created via POST /api/surveys with survey_type='pulse_check' ✓
Phase 3 - Feedback correctly implemented:
- POST /api/feedback/submit creates anonymous feedback entry (anonymous=true, status='new') ✓
- GET /api/feedback/entries returns all feedback (admin only) with filtering by category and status ✓
- PUT /api/feedback/entries/{id} updates status and allows admin response ✓
Phase 3 - Interaction Dashboard correctly implemented:
- GET /api/interaction-stats returns news stats (posts, comments, reactions, reads) ✓
- GET /api/interaction-stats returns survey stats (total, responses) ✓
- GET /api/interaction-stats returns feedback stats (total, new) ✓
- GET /api/interaction-stats returns approval_queue count ✓
Frontend correctly implemented:
- Surveys page loads with tabs (Umfragen, Pulse-Checks, Feedback) ✓
- Survey editor dialog creates surveys with all question types ✓
- Feedback dialog submits anonymous feedback with categories ✓
- Interaction stats dashboard visible for admin ✓
- News detail shows approval workflow buttons for drafts/review posts ✓

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 (Approval Workflow) and Phase 3 (Surveys, Pulse Checks, Feedback, Interaction Dashboard) are fully functional. All CRUD operations work correctly. Approval workflow: draft -> submit-review -> review -> approve-review (redakteur) -> approval -> approve-review (admin/freigeber) -> published. Or: draft -> submit-review -> review -> approve-review (admin) -> published directly. Survey question types: single_choice, multiple_choice, free_text, scale. Feedback categories: ideas, complaints, improvements, questions.
